The '''Coruscant equatorial belt''' was an area of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="C:CotE" /> region. In the year [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] the area was considered prestigious by the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Tarnese Bleyd]] who planned to purchase an apartment at the top of a [[Monad/Legends|monad]] in the equatorial belt using money from working with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization.<ref name="MI:BS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant equatorial belt first appeared in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', the first novel in the [[MedStar Duology]], written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] and published in [[2004]].<ref name="MI:BS" />
